title: Surjectivity of canonical pointed evaluation
statement: Let Y, Ω, barY and hΩ be as in [lem-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-point-evaluation-image]. The concrete ring map from the chosen coordinate-ring colimit C to the relative separable closure of the image point residue field, obtained by restricting the codomain of canonical evaluation using that image theorem, is surjective. No local-ring structure on C is assumed.

proof.text: Choose an affine chart through the point. The open-immersion residue-field isomorphism identifies the relative closures by their embeddings into Ω; hΩ and descResidueField_stalkClosedPointTo_comp give compatibility.
Use the initial chart-neighbourhood inclusion, small-model equivalence and etale_local_ring_triples to identify the coordinate-ring colimit with the residue-triple colimit, preserving coprojections.

The pointed residue equation in etale_local_ring_triples and the triple theorem coprojection equation identify the transported triple map, followed by inclusion into Ω, with the evaluation cocone on every chart-neighbourhood. Colimit uniqueness and injectivity of the closure inclusion identify the closure-valued maps. Transport the surjectivity assertion of strictHenselization_triples along those identifications.
